Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
How much priority does Astrid Thomas's ability have over others.
Her wording is:
If Astrid votes, any Tremere who choose to vote will vote with her.

It doesn't seem like there is any flexibility or choice here.

Let's take a simple case of Astrid Thomas, Etrius, and Michael Luther
all in play, controlled by different Methuselahs.
Astrid's controller calls a vote. Astrid (and hence Etrius) vote in
favor.
Can Michael Luther tap to change Etrius's votes?
Or does he have to change Astrid's votes to change Etrius's?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message news:U%Zxc.515$zz.306@attbi_s04...

> How much priority does Astrid Thomas's ability have over others.
> Her wording is:
> If Astrid votes, any Tremere who choose to vote will vote with her.
>
> It doesn't seem like there is any flexibility or choice here.

No choice at all, no.

> Let's take a simple case of Astrid Thomas, Etrius, and Michael Luther
> all in play, controlled by different Methuselahs.
> Astrid's controller calls a vote. Astrid (and hence Etrius) vote in
> favor.
> Can Michael Luther tap to change Etrius's votes?
> Or does he have to change Astrid's votes to change Etrius's?

Astrid's ability only "kicks in" after polling is finished, when you
go to tally the results.

Michael Luther uses his special during polling.
His suggestion to Etrius will be overturne by Astrid when the
time comes to count the votes.
He's have to go for Astrid to have an effect.
